beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Forty hours of the devil's best silence. And then, the third day — and a dawn that redefined every ending in history.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before sunrise, the women came with spices to finish a burial. They found the stone rolled away, the linen folded — and two men in shining garments, holding the greatest question ever asked:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is not here, but is risen.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Risen. Not resuscitated. Not remembered. Risen — body and spirit reunited forever, death running backward. Thomas touched the marks. For forty days, hundreds watched him eat, and walk, and teach.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Understand what broke that morning. Death — the devil's oldest, surest, hundred-percent weapon — became a temporary condition for every human being who ever lived. No faith required. No fee. A free gift to all, because one man walked out of a grave.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he kept an appointment six hundred years in the making. In the land of the other sheep, twenty-five hundred people stood gathered at a temple in the land Bountiful — and heard a voice out of heaven:

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: Behold my Beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased, in whom I have glorified my name — hear ye him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Remember that introduction. The Father will give it once more, in a grove of trees, eighteen centuries later. And then — he came down.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, whom the prophets testified shall come into the world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And he did not just preach to them. He invited every single person there to come, one at a time, and feel the prints in his hands and his side. It took hours. He stayed.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And the multitude went forth, and thrust their hands into his side, and did feel the prints of the nails in his hands and in his feet; and this they did do, going forth one by one until they had all gone forth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And in both hemispheres, before he left, he did the same thing: he organized his church, and he handed men the keys — apostles, prophets, the authority to baptize and to bind. The kingdom now had stewards. Hear the commission:

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So read the scoreboard. The tomb is empty. Death is temporary. Both hemispheres hold apostles with keys. The devil's checkmate piece is off the board forever — so watch him closely now. He is about to change strategies. Next: the long theft.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: The grave has been temporary for two thousand years. He made it free.
